subject: Re: Aligning demo time for CTO join / travel conflict
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudwise.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: demo@cloudwise.io
Date: 2026-09-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial demo request and timing

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the note — excited to see Redwood's runtime. Quick update: our CTO, Peter Cho, asked to join the demo but he's traveling next week and his schedule is tight. Right now he has a window on Wednesday 2026-09-16 at 4:00 PM ET (1:00 PM PT). Would Redwood be able to shift to that slot? If not, we can try Thursday morning but Peter specifically asked for the Wednesday window if possible.

Also, can you send a short SOW or one-pager that outlines the scope you'd show in the demo for our procurement team? That would help speed approvals.

Best,
Samantha Green
Head of Cloud Partnerships
CloudWise Solutions

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudwise.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial demo request and timing

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the heads up and great that Peter can join.

Short answer: yes, we can accommodate Wednesday 2026-09-16 at 1:00 PM PT. Two quick asks so we make the session high-value for an exec:
- Can we trim to a 40–45 minute executive slot (focused on architecture, performance, and ROI) and save a deeper technical walkthrough for a follow-up?
- Marcus (cc'd) will attach an updated 1-pager / SOW and a 1-slide exec-ROI that we can include in the invite.

I will move the calendar invite once Marcus confirms details. If there's any other stakeholder you'd like added (procurement, security), let us know.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial demo request and timing

Samantha / Olga — attaching the short agenda and SOW draft.

Attachment: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (1-page agenda, exec + tech split)
Attachment: SOW-draft-v0.3.docx (scoping & next-steps, redlines welcome)

Proposed structure for Wed 9/16 1:00 PM PT (40 min):
- 1:00–1:05 PM PT: quick intros + goals (Olga)
- 1:05–1:25 PM PT: exec-level architecture & perf highlights (Karthik)
- 1:25–1:40 PM PT: key outcomes, pricing/next steps (Marcus)

If Peter wants deeper kernel-level notes we can follow with a technical deep-dive next week.

I will send the updated invite to the demo alias once Olga confirms.

—Marcus Lin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudwise.io>

Cc: demo@cloudwise.io

Subject: Re: Initial demo request and timing

Perfect — thanks Marcus. That structure looks good. One small ask from Peter: can you include an explicit slide showing production latency and cost per 1M tokens vs. our current vendor (we use two models today)? He only needs a high-level comparison.

Also, procurement will want the SOW; I'll circulate internally once I have it. If you can send me the invite with the updated agenda and attendee list, I'll lock in Peter on our side.

Best,
Samantha

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>

Samantha — thanks, will do. Karthik (cc) will take the latency/cost slide and highlight a short comparison we can present live.

I updated the invite for Wed 2026-09-16 1:00 PM PT and sent via Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234. Please let me know if any additional attendees should be added.

Next steps:
